_comment: Hand-written catalog entries the generator cannot introspect. scripts/build_console_catalog.py verifies every class and method named here exists (ast, no import), so an entry cannot outlive its code.

library.what: E1/E2/E3 HEMP, intentional EMI and geomagnetic-disturbance (GIC) classification with threat level, grid impact and protective actions.
code: # IEC 61000-2-9 E1 benchmark from the module docstring: 50 kV/m x 1.3 (exp(-4e7 t) - exp(-6e8 t))
det = EMPDetector()  # enable_e1_detection, enable_e3_detection, enable_attack_classification default True
library.via: the registry detector emp (EMPRecordAdapter wraps EMPDetector)

library.what: E1 (HEMP early time) from a field sensor: peak field above 10 kV/m, 10-90% rise below 10 ns, content within 1-1000 MHz. Takes a sampled record or summary values.
code: # IEC 61000-2-9 E1 benchmark from the module docstring: 50 kV/m x 1.3 (exp(-4e7 t) - exp(-6e8 t))
library.via: the registry detector emp (EMPDetector runs it)

library.what: E2 (HEMP intermediate time), 10-100 V/m from about 0.01 µs to 1 ms. Reported only after a detected E1, since alone it looks like lightning.
library.via: the registry detector emp (EMPDetector runs it)

library.what: E3 (HEMP late time) from a magnetometer: |dB/dt| of at least 450 nT/s for at least 1 s. Below that floor it grades geomagnetic-disturbance grid impact on 1-minute tiers.
code: # dbdt_cadence_s other than 60 reports grid impact as "unassessed"
library.via: the registry detector emp (EMPDetector runs it)

library.what: Neural intentional-EMI classifier (torch nn.Module). Train it with train_iemi_network; EMPDetector.load_neural_weights(path) loads the weights. Until then intentional_attack_probability stays None.
library.via: the registry detector emp, once EMPDetector.load_neural_weights(path) has loaded trained weights

library.what: CISA Energy & Dams sector checks: grid frequency deviation, dam seepage and water level, with cascading-risk and downstream-impact estimates.

voice --domain.note: narrative/voice.py passes the domain through sanitize_domain (cognitive/ethical_bounding.py), which keeps only EnvironmentDomain labels (cognitive/ipb_engine.py) plus general. Anything else becomes general. That includes energy, security, humanitarian and scientific: the agent planner's DomainType has them, EnvironmentDomain does not.

energy: alerting/cap_generator.py files energy alerts under INFRA

voice --model.note: Models named in OllamaModel (models/foundation/ollama_adapter.py). Any model installed in your local Ollama works; add one with ollama pull NAME. With no --model and no MERCURY_OLLAMA_MODEL, replies fall back to templates.
voice --model.unset: not set · falls back to MERCURY_OLLAMA_MODEL
